paragraphs.text: Ellina Tanglewood is the barista at the Firejolt Café on Arcavios .

The Firejolt Café is a popular spot for students at Strixhaven , and the barista Ellina is part of the reason. She is known for the atmosphere she creates in the café - she is generous, supportive, and kind-hearted, offering free drinks to mages to commemorate the end-of-session exams. She fosters a sense of community and celebration among the students with her friendly and sociable character. She is also thoughtful, programming her waiter-imps to recite a welcoming mantra ( "All Drinks Are on the House Today" ), demonstrating her attention to detail and consideration for her patrons' experience. Ellina is responsible for making and serving beverages, as well as overseeing the operation of the café. She has programmed waiter-imps to assist in serving drinks and delivering messages to customers, managing both staff and magical elements of the café.
